units.source_text: 且说源氏公子长此闲居一室，沉思冥想，实非所宜，便发心入宫参见桐壶院。

en.t: Now Prince Genji had been idling so long in one room, lost in dark thought, that it was truly no good for him, and he resolved to go into the palace to visit the Kiritsubo Emperor.
The carriage had already been made ready, and the attendants had all assembled.

units.source_text: 天公体会人意，降下一番时雨，仿佛为此别离而洒同情之泪。

en.t: As if heaven understood human feelings, a passing shower fell, seeming to shed tears of sympathy for this parting.

units.source_text: 摧残木叶的寒风蓦地剧烈起来。

en.t: The cold wind that battered the leaves suddenly grew fierce.

units.source_text: 在旁侍候的诸人，尽皆垂头丧气。

en.t: All those waiting in attendance nearby hung their heads in dejection.

units.source_text: 近日稍干的衣袖，今日又湿透了。

en.t: Sleeves that had only recently begun to dry were soaked through again today.

units.source_text: 预定出宫之后，今夜即在二条院私邸泊宿。

en.t: It had been decided that after leaving the palace, he would spend the night at his private residence at Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 侍从人等便各做准备，先赴二条院等候。

en.t: The attendants therefore each made their preparations and went ahead to Nijo-in to wait.

units.source_text: 公子今日并非一去不回，但左大臣邸内诸人都悲伤不堪。

en.t: The prince was not leaving today never to return, yet everyone in the Minister of the Left's residence was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 左大臣夫妇见此光景，又添了一种新愁。

en.t: Seeing this scene, the Minister of the Left and his wife felt a new sorrow added to their hearts.
